question: Can a prospectively sealed present-day/days-gone-by and current/former-age bank serve as pristine confirmation for whichever read/write mechanism the already queued v20 split selects?

searched: all is/was fresh-lexicon builders and target surfaces v1-v20
all capability, factor-program, paraphrase-control, and task-functional tensor receipts
active board claims, canonical temporal dossier, BILIN18_CONNECTION, and BENCHMARK_BACKLOG
prior_art.known_lessons: Capability must precede causal access. V20 showed that target transfer can coexist with a strong same-answer paraphrase failure, so P and C must remain separate mandatory panels. The next confirmation corpus must be fixed before the v20 writer/reader split outcome selects a repair.
prior_art.novelty: No v21 bank exists. Sixteen reporter nouns, every A1/A2/P text, every row ID, and both target construction surfaces are history-disjoint from v1-v20. The bank is sealed while the read/write split remains queued and before any v21 model outcome.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides; no intervention, read/write tensor, factor, gate, subspace, gradient, gain, or causal outcome is read.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder/digests, construction checks, full-history target-text/row-ID/reporter novelty, and exact 64-row inventory pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_a_panel_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least .75.
predictions.pred_c_joint_capable_population: Each 16-row A panel has at least 12 rows for which both native base and donor predictions are correct.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples, zero interventions/backwards/updates, and no causal or mechanism outcome access.

decision: A pass freezes exact v21 confirmation rows without choosing a repair. A null closes this bank without causal repair and requires a separately authored construction.
